violated_contract: A projection job whose source conversation was deleted, with no deletion tombstone and no redirect, must end in a terminal disposition that publishes nothing and writes no usage. A tombstone-required guard that only blocks and retries leaves the job non-terminal for good.
canonical_prevention: Admit the deleted-source case to a terminal source_deleted disposition at session admission; suppress every output ID across parts before publish; skip usage on that path. A kill switch restores the prior blocking behavior.
